changelog:
alibabacloud-dts-task-query v0.0.1

- Initial release supporting comprehensive DTS task querying across all Alibaba Cloud regions.
- Queries all 27 regions and 3 job types (Migration, Sync, Subscribe) with strict PayType filtering.
- Outputs complete, grouped Chinese reports including every task (no truncation or summarization).
- Enhanced reliability: API retry logic (up to 3 times), 10s timeout, exponential backoff (0.2s, 0.4s).
- Parallel execution using configurable worker threads, achieving up to 8x faster results.
